preconditions.description: The length of the array n is between 2 and 140582 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(b) == n and all(0 <= x <= 187126 for x in b)
preconditions.description: The input array b contains exactly n integers, each between 0 and 187126 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (stdout.strip().split()[0] in ['YES', 'yes', 'Yes'] and len(stdout.strip().split()) == n + 1)
postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' or starts with 'YES' followed by exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**18 for x in stdout.strip().split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', all restored array elements a_i are positive integers not exceeding 10^18.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (all(b[i] == int(stdout.strip().split()[i+1]) % int(stdout.strip().split()[(i+1) % n + 1]) for i in range(n)))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', the restored array a satisfies the cyclic modulo condition b_i = a_i mod a_{i+1} (with a_{n+1} = a_1) for all i.

postconditions.expression: not (stdout.strip() == 'NO' and any(all(b[i] == a[i] % a[(i+1) % n] for i in range(n)) and all(1 <= x <= 10**18 for x in a) for a in [list(range(1, 10**18+1))]))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'NO', no valid array a exists that satisfies the conditions.
